audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 10 sketch identification by image key, garment, visible detail, and design quality.
audio_prompts.script: Look at image A to image D. Number one: This sketch shows a figure in a front view. The figure is wearing a black jacket, a white shirt, and blue jeans. The jacket has a zipper and two pockets. The silhouette is straight and casual. Number two: This sketch shows a long green dress. The dress has a V-neckline, short sleeves, and a loose silhouette. The fabric looks lightweight and flowy. Number three: This figure is wearing a pink blouse and a flared skirt. The color palette is soft and warm. The skirt has pleats and a hem below the knee. Number four: This sketch shows a bright streetwear look. The figure is wearing an oversized orange hoodie and black shorts. The pose is relaxed.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each number.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
